title: Deep learning screening finds a covalent ligand for a proposed Keap1 Cys434 site
summary: Mutagenesis, mass spectrometry, molecular dynamics, binding assays and docking indicated that Cys434 in Keap1 may be a covalent allosteric site engaged by dimethyl fumarate. A deep-learning screen of 350,000 small molecules yielded six predicted covalent ligands; fumaramide was shown to modify Cys434, activate Nrf2 and alleviate injury in a mouse acute lung injury model.
ai_technology: Deep-learning-based virtual screening of 350,000 small molecules

evidence.tested: In vitro mutagenesis, mass spectrometry and binding assays, cell assays and a mouse acute lung injury model.
evidence.unknown: Cys434 site described as possible; mouse model only; model architecture not stated in the abstract; the DMF-Cys434 evidence came from non-AI methods; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning screening prioritized candidate covalent ligands for the proposed site.
